summary: PEC-PG is a Brazilian government programme, coordinated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, CAPES and CNPq, that funds full master's and doctoral degrees in academic (stricto sensu) postgraduate programmes at Brazilian higher education and research institutions for nationals of participating countries. In the 2027 cycle, CNPq Call 16/2026 first chooses the Brazilian institutions, which then run their own selection of foreign candidates; the call covers up to 100 master's and 100 doctoral scholarships starting between March 2027 and March 2028. Scholarships give a monthly stipend, access to the public health system and a return allowance.
eligibility_notes:
Candidates must be foreign nationals of a country that takes part in the programme and must live abroad in a participating country. They must not have Brazilian nationality, dual Brazilian nationality or a right to Brazilian nationality at registration, and must not hold permanent residence in Brazil. They must prove a completed course that the Brazilian system treats as equal to an undergraduate degree, must not already be studying a course of the same level in Brazil, must not owe anything to CNPq or be on federal debtor lists, and must be able to start academic activities at once within the deadline of the postgraduate programme. A current Lattes CV is required. They must meet the academic and language requirements of the master's or doctoral programme they choose; all requirements add up and must all be met. Language proof is given to the programme according to its own procedure.

Previous scholarships: former PEC-G graduates, and anyone who had a Brazilian funding agency scholarship for an undergraduate degree in Brazil, must have stayed at least two years in their home country or country of residence after receiving the Brazilian diploma. Anyone who had a Brazilian funding agency master's scholarship (including a former CAPES or CNPq PEC-PG scholar) must have stayed at least two years after getting the master's title. A doctoral applicant must not have had a doctoral sandwich or full doctoral scholarship from a federal public body before, and a master's applicant must not have had a master's sandwich or full master's scholarship from one. Nobody may hold a doctorate, whatever the level applied for.

Priority: for doctoral places, institutions give priority where possible to candidates who studied both undergraduate and master's degrees outside Brazil; for master's places, to candidates who studied the undergraduate degree outside Brazil. A foreign degree does not have to be revalidated. Applicants agree that CNPq, CAPES and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs may process their personal data, including to keep in touch with the alumni network. Only academic (not professional) master's and doctoral programmes are supported.
age_experience_notes: No age limit and no minimum work experience are stated in the call or the embassy note. Institutions may set their own conditions.
funding_summary: The master's scholarship runs 24 months at BRL 2,100 per month, and the doctoral scholarship 48 months at BRL 3,100 per month; shorter scholarships are not approved. Students also have access to the public health system, and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs pays a return allowance to the home country when the budget allows. The programme does not pay the flight to Brazil, accommodation or settlement allowance, aid for spouses or family, or academic and administrative fees of the Brazilian institution, and the selected candidate pays travel to Brazil and living costs until the first payment.
programmes_note: Only academic master's and doctoral programmes (stricto sensu) recognised by the Brazilian education authorities are supported; professional master's and doctoral programmes are not. Each institution ties its places to strategic research themes and may support programmes in several fields, preferably across disciplines. The 2027 call does not list fields or programmes: the institutions chosen by CNPq publish their own places and criteria. In the previous cycle (CAPES Edital 12/2025), a sandwich doctorate of 6 to 10 months was also offered; the 2027 call text read does not mention it.
institutions_note: In the 2027 cycle, Brazilian higher education institutions and science, technology and innovation institutions applied to CNPq by 13 August 2026 for scholarship quotas. Each institution may receive 0 to 3 master's and 0 to 3 doctoral scholarships (up to 6) if it is still building its internationalisation, or 0 to 5 and 0 to 5 (up to 10) if it is already internationalised. The list of chosen institutions is promised for December 2026 on the CNPq website; at the time of checking the list is not yet published. Candidates apply directly to the institution of their choice, which runs its own selection and calendar.

summary.detail: Full master's degree in an academic postgraduate programme at a Brazilian institution chosen by CNPq. Scholarship of 24 months, BRL 2,100 per month; up to 100 master's scholarships in the call. Master's applicants must not already hold a master's or doctoral title and must not have had a federal master's scholarship before. Priority, where possible, for those who did their undergraduate degree outside Brazil.

Full doctorate in an academic postgraduate programme at a Brazilian institution chosen by CNPq. Scholarship of 48 months, BRL 3,100 per month; up to 100 doctoral scholarships in the call. Applicants must not hold a doctorate or have had a federal doctoral scholarship before. Priority, where possible, for those who did both undergraduate and master's degrees outside Brazil.

benefits.limit_text: BRL 2,100 per month for a master's degree, for 24 months
benefits.conditions: Shorter master's scholarships are not approved. Paid by the funding agency, subject to its budget; values follow the agency's scholarship table.

benefits.limit_text: BRL 3,100 per month for a doctorate, for 48 months
benefits.conditions: Shorter doctoral scholarships are not approved.

benefits.limit_text: Access to Brazil's public health system (SUS) on equal terms with Brazilians
benefits.conditions: In the previous cycle, students also had to buy their own health insurance (with medical, hospital and repatriation cover) and received a one-time health insurance allowance of BRL 400. The 2027 call refers to the CNPq scholarship table, which was not read, so the 2027 insurance allowance is unconfirmed.

benefits.limit_text: Return allowance to the home country, paid by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
benefits.conditions: Subject to the Ministry's budget; paid whatever the reason the scholarship payments stopped, unless the home-country agreement already provides it. The value varies by country (carried over from stored data).

benefits.limit_text: The flight to Brazil is not financed
benefits.conditions: The selected candidate pays for travel to Brazil and living needs until the first monthly payment; the previous call asked for own funds for at least 60 days.

benefits.limit_text: Accommodation of any kind, including a settlement allowance, is not financed
benefits.conditions: Also not financed: connections, baggage, fees, fines, refunds or transfers; aid for spouse, dependants or relatives. The institution must help the student find suitable accommodation (previous call).

benefits.limit_text: Academic and administrative fees of the Brazilian institution are not financed by the programme
benefits.conditions: The sources read do not say whether the participating institutions charge such fees. The stored statement of a free place is not confirmed.

requirements.text: Scanned copy of the passport page with personal information.
Proof of registration status of the Brazilian taxpayer number (CPF).
Proof of residence abroad, for example a utility bill.
A valid ORCID researcher identifier, entered directly in the application form.

Research project written in Portuguese, Spanish or English and presented to the institution. In the previous cycle it had to cover introduction, aims, why training in Brazil is needed, expected results, publication goals, how the knowledge will be spread at home, a work schedule and references.
Complete, up-to-date Lattes CV in Portuguese.
Employer's statement of employment, current and written in Portuguese, Spanish or English.
Statement from the graduate programme proving regular enrolment in a master's or doctoral course, and that the stay in Brazil will not go beyond the maximum time to defend the dissertation or thesis.
requirements.conditional_rule: listed in the call for scholarship indication, after the institution selects you

requirements.text: Proof of a completed degree equal to a Brazilian undergraduate degree (and a master's for doctoral candidates in the previous cycle), with simple translation into Portuguese, English or Spanish if needed. Revalidation of the foreign degree is not asked.
requirements.conditional_rule: documents asked by the previous CAPES call; the institution sets the 2027 list

requirements.text: Academic transcript with full marks of the undergraduate (and master's) degree, with simple translation if needed.
requirements.conditional_rule: documents asked by the previous CAPES call; the institution sets the 2027 list

requirements.text: Personal statement (memorial) of up to 600 words on skills, motivation, training and teaching, research and outreach experience, and special circumstances.
requirements.conditional_rule: asked by the previous CAPES call; the institution sets the 2027 list

requirements.text: Proof of language proficiency, shown to the postgraduate programme according to its own procedure.
Documents may be in Portuguese, English or Spanish, or accompanied by a simple translation into one of them.

application_steps.title: Wait for the list of participating institutions
application_steps.detail: In the 2027 cycle CNPq first selects the Brazilian institutions. The call was published on 29 June 2026, institutions applied by 13 August 2026, the preliminary result is due in November 2026 and the final decision, with the list of institutions, in December 2026. Scholarship selection and start run from March 2027 to March 2028.

application_steps.title: Choose an institution and programme, check its criteria
application_steps.detail: Candidates apply directly to the Brazilian institution of their choice. Each institution and postgraduate programme sets its own selection criteria and calendar, within the general PEC-PG rules, and publishes its opportunities widely. Check the programme's academic and language requirements, because all requirements add up.

application_steps.title: Prepare and submit the application to the institution
application_steps.detail: Prepare a current Lattes CV, an ORCID number, a research project in Portuguese, Spanish or English, passport page, CPF status proof, proof of residence abroad, and any employer statement. The exact application form and deadline are set by each institution; none is yet stated for 2027.

application_steps.title: The institution selects; CNPq and the Ministry are told
application_steps.detail: The final choice of scholarship holders belongs only to the participating institutions. They send the list of selected candidates to CNPq before indicating the scholarships on the CNPq platform, and CNPq shares it with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Institutions have 12 months from the publication of the result to indicate candidates; unused scholarships go back to CNPq.

application_steps.title: What programmes look at (previous-cycle criteria)
application_steps.detail: In the previous CAPES cycle, selection looked at whether minimum requirements and documents were met, how the training in Brazil fits the candidate's project, academic and professional record, and motivation to study in Brazil. It ran in three rounds (first and second programme choice, then a final round), with homologation by the institution's postgraduate dean and a document check by CAPES. Women and older candidates, border regions and the North, Northeast and Centre-West were preferred when places exceeded the budget. The 2027 call leaves this to each institution.

application_steps.title: Accept the scholarship, get the visa and the Brazilian tax number
application_steps.detail: In the previous cycle the selected candidate had 30 days to accept, had to obtain the Brazilian CPF, sign the scholarship term (Termo de Outorga), register acceptance in the scholarship system, and open a Brazilian bank account. The candidate must secure the proper visa before buying the ticket and keep a regular migration status. Check the 2027 steps with the institution and the funding agency.

application_steps.title: Study, keep up progress and return home
application_steps.detail: Scholars start with the institution's academic calendar and must stay active in academic work or the scholarship can be suspended or cancelled. In the previous cycle there was an intermediate evaluation in year one of the master's and year two of the doctorate to decide on continuing, and holders could leave Brazil for field research in their home country for up to 12 months in total if their work plan allows. The programme expects scholars to return to their home country when the link ends; the Ministry of Foreign Affairs pays the return allowance when its budget allows.

fetch_problems: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs PEC-PG pages (selection process, about page, participating countries) show a human-verification check (HTTP 429) and were not opened or bypassed.
The CNPq scholarship value table (Portaria 1.502/2023) and the joint regulation (Portaria 936/2024) were not opened.
notes: Stored eligibility said the country list was not readable; it is still not: the call refers to a Ministry page that is blocked. The 2026-cycle CAPES call listed 74 countries (29 in Africa, 28 in Latin America and the Caribbean, 10 in Asia, 7 in Europe), but the 2027 list may differ.
The free place statement in stored benefits is not confirmed; the sources only say the programme does not pay academic and administrative fees to the host institution.

Several details (documents list, selection rounds, grant acceptance, rights and duties) come from the previous CAPES Edital 12/2025; the 2027 edition is decentralised and institutions may set different rules.
